Flipping the rate-based rule (priority 1, COUNT, 300/5min/IP) to BLOCK is NOT proposed here: this low-volume probe (210 req over ~10 min) never approached the threshold, and flipping it risks blocking legitimate high-traffic clients — noted as a separate optional owner decision.
